title: Making AI-generated interfaces consistent
summary: Tooling and guardrails so generated screens follow the design system every time.

body.heading: Challenge
body.text: Generated UI drifted from brand and component rules.

body.heading: Approach
body.text: Encoded design rules as structured guidance the generator could follow, then tested outputs against them.

body.heading: Outcome
body.text: Describe the improvement in consistency and review time.
